text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City! Thanks a bunch for the birthday 
present!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You're welcome. ...Well, feel free to use 
it if it suits your taste."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I totally love it!! It's stylish, 
gorgeous... and it has such a lovely, 
sweet, gentle scent!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And it smells like bananas, my absolute 
favorite! ...Ehehe, you remembered! That 
makes me super happy too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously. When you see someone 
eating with such a big smile every single 
day, of course you're gonna remember what 
they like.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man~! I love that scent way too much—my 
stomach growls every single time I catch a 
whiff of it~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so like you, Bamboo-sen— 
...Gh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bamboo-senpai... Just to be safe, you 
know that's not actually food, right...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It needs to be refrigerated, so I put it 
in the dorm's shared fridge. It has 
"butter" in its name and smells delicious, 
but it's actually a moisturizing skin 
cream—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I-I got it! Don't worry, I memorized it 
already!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna spread something on toast 
and eat it just 'cause it's named 'butter' 
ever again~!!
